sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best completes each conversation.

sections.title: SUGGESTIONS AND ADVICE
sections.instruction: Choose the most appropriate suggestion, advice, or response.

sections.title: REQUESTS, OFFERS, AND INVITATIONS
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that fits the speaker's purpose and the reply.

sections.instruction: Choose the most natural response in each situation.

sections.title: CLARIFICATION, PREFERENCES, AND POSSIBILITY
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best completes each conversation.

questions.prompt:
A: “Replacing printed notices with a school app sounds efficient.”
B: “____. We should also make sure that students without reliable internet can get the information.”
choices: I agree, although access needs to be considered.
I completely disagree with every part of that idea.
I have no idea what a school app is.
You should ask the librarian for directions.
I'm sorry that the notices were printed.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Qualified Agreement.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar adalah ungkapan yang menunjukkan setuju, tetapi tetap menyampaikan hal yang perlu diperhatikan. Pembicara mendukung penggunaan aplikasi, namun mengingatkan bahwa semua siswa harus tetap bisa mendapat informasi.

questions.prompt:
A: “The school should cancel all group projects because some students do not contribute equally.”
B: “____. Group projects can still be useful if each member has a clear responsibility.”
choices: I see your point, but I wouldn't go that far.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Polite Disagreement.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar menunjukkan bahwa pembicara memahami alasan lawan bicara, tetapi tidak sepenuhnya setuju. Kalimat berikutnya memberikan pandangan yang berbeda.

questions.prompt:
A: “Do you think the new study area will help students concentrate?”
B: “____, especially if it stays quiet during study hours.”
choices: I strongly object to the idea
I insist that it has already failed
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing a Tentative Opinion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar adalah “I'd say it probably will”, karena pembicara menyampaikan pendapat dengan cukup yakin tetapi tidak menganggapnya sebagai kepastian. Syaratnya, area itu tetap tenang.

questions.prompt:
A: “This survey proves that every student prefers online assignments.”
B: “____. Only a small group of students took part in it.”
choices: I'm not entirely convinced by that conclusion.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing Reservation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar menunjukkan keraguan terhadap kesimpulan. Alasannya, hanya sedikit siswa yang mengikuti survei, sehingga hasilnya belum tentu mewakili semua siswa.

questions.prompt:
A: “I have several assignments due on the same day, and I don't know where to begin.”
B: “____. Start with the one that is due first, then plan the rest.”
choices: You shouldn't have studied at all.
Why don't you ignore every assignment?
I'm afraid I can't understand the calendar.
I wish I had more homework.
If I were in your position, I'd make a priority list.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving Advice.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar menggunakan pola “If I were in your position, I'd ...” untuk memberi saran. Membuat daftar prioritas membantu menentukan tugas mana yang harus dikerjakan lebih dulu.

questions.prompt:
A: “We need to prepare the classroom for the exhibition.”
B: “____ divide the work into decorating, arranging the displays, and welcoming visitors?”
choices: I regret to inform you that we
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Suggestion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar adalah “Shall we ...?”, yang digunakan untuk mengusulkan kegiatan bersama. Pembicara mengajak kelompok membagi tugas persiapan pameran.

questions.prompt:
A: “I am going to submit my project without checking the references.”
B: “____ check them once more before you submit it.”
choices: I couldn't agree more that you
Would you like me to avoid
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving Cautious Advice.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar adalah “You might want to ...”, ungkapan yang memberi saran dengan nada tidak memaksa. Memeriksa referensi sekali lagi dapat membantu menghindari kesalahan.

questions.prompt:
A: “We could practise our presentation in front of a smaller group first.”
B: “____. That would help us feel more confident before presenting to the whole class.”
choices: I don't see any reason to prepare.
I'm afraid I have already left.
I would rather cancel the presentation.
I have no idea who suggested it.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Suggestion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar adalah “That's worth trying”, yang berarti usulan itu layak dicoba. Kalimat berikutnya menjelaskan manfaat dari usulan tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “____ sending me the updated schedule when you have a moment?”
B: “Certainly. I'll email it this afternoon.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Polite Request.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah “Would you mind ...?”, yang digunakan untuk meminta bantuan dengan sopan. Jawaban “Certainly” menunjukkan bahwa permintaan itu diterima.

questions.prompt:
A: “You seem to have a lot of materials to carry.”
B: “____ take some of them to the staff room for you?”
A: “That's very kind of you.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Offering Assistance.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar adalah “Would you like me to ...?”, yang digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan. Respons “That's very kind of you” menunjukkan bahwa tawaran tersebut dihargai.

questions.prompt:
A: “We would be delighted if you could attend the student research presentation next Friday.”
B: “____. Thank you for including me.”
choices: I'm afraid I won't be able to attend.
I have already made other plans.
I don't think invitations are necessary.
Perhaps you should ask someone else.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Accepting a Formal Invitation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar menerima undangan dengan sopan dan sesuai untuk situasi formal. Ucapan terima kasih setelahnya memperkuat bahwa pembicara bersedia hadir.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you be available to join the committee meeting on Saturday?”
B: “____. I have already committed to a family event that day.”
choices: That sounds excellent; count me in.
Thank you, but I'm afraid I won't be able to make it.
I look forward to seeing everyone.
I completely agree with the proposal.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Declining an Invitation Politely.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar menolak undangan dengan sopan. Pembicara juga memberikan alasan, yaitu sudah memiliki acara keluarga pada hari itu.

questions.prompt:
A: “I should have told you earlier that I couldn't attend the rehearsal. I'm sorry for the trouble.”
B: “____. Please let us know sooner next time so we can make other arrangements.”
choices: That is exactly what I wanted to hear.
Would you like to join us?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to an Apology.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar menerima permintaan maaf dengan sopan. Kalimat berikutnya menyampaikan harapan agar orang tersebut memberi kabar lebih awal lain kali.

questions.prompt:
A: “I really appreciate you staying late to help me finish the display.”
B: “____. I'm glad I could help.”
choices: I'm sorry you feel that way.
It was no trouble at all.
I would rather not discuss it.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to Gratitude.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah ungkapan untuk merespons ucapan terima kasih. “It was no trouble at all” berarti bantuan itu tidak merepotkan.

questions.prompt:
A: “Your analysis of the poem was thoughtful and well supported.”
B: “____. I spent quite a bit of time checking the examples.”
choices: Thank you; I'm glad it was useful.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Compliment.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar menerima pujian dengan sopan. Pembicara juga menjelaskan bahwa ia berusaha memeriksa contoh-contohnya dengan baik.

questions.prompt:
A: “Congratulations on being selected to represent the school in the debate competition!”
B: “____. The whole team helped me prepare.”
choices: Thank you. I couldn't have done it without their support.
I'm sorry I missed the event.
I would rather not take part.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to Congratulations.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar menerima ucapan selamat dan mengakui bantuan tim. Ini merupakan respons yang wajar setelah seseorang berhasil terpilih.

questions.prompt:
A: “Please make your report more concise.”
B: “____? Should I remove repeated points, or shorten every section?”
A: “Start by removing repeated points.”
choices: Could you clarify what you mean by “concise”
Do you happen to know the answer
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking for Clarification.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar meminta penjelasan lebih lanjut tentang arti “concise”. Pertanyaan setelahnya menunjukkan bahwa pembicara ingin memastikan tindakan yang harus dilakukan.

questions.prompt:
A: “The results suggest that sleep quality affects memory.”
B: “____ how that relationship works?”
A: “Certainly. Sleep helps the brain process and store information.”
choices: Would you mind if I left
Do you agree that it is impossible
Could you explain in a little more detail
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking for Further Explanation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar meminta penjelasan yang lebih rinci. Respons berikutnya memberikan informasi tambahan tentang hubungan tidur dan ingatan.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you prefer to present first or after the break?”
B: “____ present after the break, if that's possible. I need a little more time to prepare.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing a Preference.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah “I'd prefer to ...”, yang digunakan untuk menyatakan pilihan yang lebih disukai. Pembicara memilih tampil setelah istirahat karena membutuhkan waktu persiapan.

questions.prompt:
A: “Will the outdoor exhibition go ahead tomorrow?”
B: “____, although the organizers are still checking the weather forecast.”
choices: It is impossible under every circumstance
I have no preference either way
There is a good chance it will
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing Probability.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar menunjukkan bahwa acara kemungkinan besar tetap berlangsung, tetapi belum pasti. Bagian “although ... checking the weather forecast” menunjukkan masih ada ketidakpastian.
